text: {"verdict": "insufficient", "answer": "The retrieved evidence does not test mechanical circulatory support at all; the POSEIDON trial [40164383] compared transendocardial injections of allogeneic vs autologous bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells in ischemic cardiomyopathy, not devices for acute myocardial infarction.
